metadata.decision_statement: The 55 high confidence ClinVar concordant biological candidates are accepted as the proposed primary Phase 2C evaluation cohort. Acceptance is based on predefined provenance, deterministic molecular evaluation, concordance, and historical separation criteria. The cohort is not considered independently validated ground truth and contains known class representation limitations. These limitations are retained transparently rather than addressed through artificial candidate substitution or class balancing.
metadata.scientific_status: 55 high confidence ClinVar concordant biological candidates proposed for the primary Phase 2C evaluation cohort.
